name: Conway's Law
axiom: A system's structure ends up copying the communication structure of the teams that built it.
trigger: Two teams own half a flow each, and the product asks users to cross a seam no user would draw.

checklist.text: Organise menus by the user's jobs, not by the departments that own the backend services.
Share one set of design tokens across services so separately built screens look related.
Merge settings the back end splits across services behind one account screen.
Before a reorganisation ships, map its team boundaries onto the screens users must cross.

antiPattern.violation: A telecom portal sends customers to three subdomains with different themes to manage phone, broadband, and billing.
antiPattern.remediation: One identity and one design shell put all three offerings in a single services dashboard.
